race.comment: SMASHING NOVA (5) goes on top after finishing second here, beaten a length, despite being held up passing the 350m. His 1200m and wet-track records are strong for this grade. EXTREME SPIRIT (7) is ticking along nicely with two thirds this campaign at this track, the latest a long-neck defeat on soft ground when respected in an open market. Third-up now and proven handy enough on wet ground, he can put it all together this time and break a long run of outs. ZOODOO (3) hasn't raced since May but was readied with a two trials, improving in the latest. Proven fresh and both career wins have come at this distance. EXCESSOR (6) is race fit now and has claims off a second here two back.
